summary: The registrant, HPS Corporate Capital Solutions Fund, filed an 8-K to report routine periodic sales of unregistered equity securities (common shares) under subscription agreements, along with regular and special distribution declarations and net asset value updates as of May 31, 2026. The transaction involved issuance of Class I, D, and S shares at $26.93 per share for total consideration of approximately $16.91 million. The issuance is exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S. This is a normal capital-raising and distribution activity, not a special situation event. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; standard regulatory compliance.
